unavailable_definition: all connection requests to the applicable running DB resource fail during a 1-minute interval
partial_month_rule: if the DB resource ran for only part of the month, it is assumed 100% available for the portion of the month it was not running

commitments.claim_subject: Amazon RDS SLA Credit Request – Multi-AZ Claim
Amazon RDS SLA Credit Request – Single-DB Claim

formula: 100% - percentage of 1-minute intervals during the monthly billing cycle in which the applicable DB resource was Unavailable
billing_basis: charges paid for the affected Multi-AZ DB Instance, Multi-AZ DB Cluster, or Single-DB Instance in the affected AWS Region for the monthly billing cycle in which the applicable SLA was not met
minimum_credit_condition: credit amount for applicable monthly billing cycle must be greater than USD 1
non_stacking: claims under the Multi-AZ commitment and Single-DB commitment may not be combined or stacked
claim_requirements: dates and times of each Unavailability incident claimed
DB Instance IDs and AWS Regions for affected DB resources
request logs documenting errors and corroborating the claimed outage
exclusions: factors outside AWS reasonable control including force majeure or Internet/access issues beyond RDS demarcation point
Micro DB instance class or other classes with similar CPU/memory limitations
failure to follow basic operational guidelines
underlying database engine software causing repeated crashes or an inoperable database instance
long recovery caused by insufficient IO capacity for the workload
customer equipment, software or other technology
AWS suspension or termination of customer right to use RDS
evidence_requirements: connection request logs sufficient to establish that all connection requests failed in each claimed 1-minute interval
DB deployment mode/engine and resource identifiers
resource lifecycle evidence for partial-month cases
billing charges for the affected DB resource and billing cycle
unresolved: effective_from and immutable official source snapshot/hash
non-USD treatment of the >USD 1 minimum condition
provider validation requirements beyond request logs in ambiguous engine/crash/exclusion cases
notes: DRAFT only; not approved for financial decisions.
Generic CloudWatch DB metrics do not by themselves prove that all connection requests failed.
Historical incident selection must not assume source_last_updated equals effective_from; ambiguous version boundaries return REVIEW_REQUIRED.
